Combat Expertise.name: Combat Expertise: -[[1+floor(@attributes.bab.total/4)]] melee attack & CMB for +[[1+floor(@attributes.bab.total/4)]] dodge AC

Dramatic Display.name: Dramatic Display: +[[2]] CMB until end of next turn

Drunken Brawler.name: Drunken Brawler (drunk): +[[2]] alchemical Fort & Will, -[[2]] Reflex

Improved Back to Back.name: Improved Back to Back: +2 AC vs flankers [[2]]

Multiweapon Defense.name: Multiweapon Defense: forgo off-hand attacks for +[[1]] each (max +5) shield bonus to AC

Reward of Grace.name: Reward of Grace: lay on hands used this round

Risky Striker.name: Risky Striker: -[[1]] AC (vs creatures 2+ sizes larger only)

Savage Display.name: Savage Display: performance combat check made (until end of next turn)

Shield of Swings.name: Shield of Swings: full-attack with a two-handed weapon, reduce your weapon damage by [[1/2]] to gain a +[[4]] shield bonus to AC and a +[[4]] shield bonus to CMD until your next turn

Unsanctioned Detection.name: Unsanctioned Detection: +10 sacred Perception & Sense Motive (1 rd, expends detect evil 24h)

Demon Hunter.name: Demon Hunter (vs demons): +2 morale on attack rolls

Ferocious Loyalty.name: Ferocious Loyalty: +1 morale on attack rolls vs a foe threatening an ally who also has this feat (+2 morale for 1 min if such an ally is downed/killed within 30 ft)

Bloody Vengeance.name: Bloody Vengeance: vs a studied foe that has damaged you within the last minute, your melee hits deal +[[1]] bleed damage

Bear Hug.name: Bear Hug: +2 bonus on damage rolls against foes you are grappling.

Bloodstone Manhunter.name: Bloodstone Manhunter: +1 on weapon attack and damage rolls and on Bluff/Knowledge/Perception/Sense Motive/Survival checks against humans (does not stack with a favored enemy bonus vs humans).

Champion.name: Champion: Swift action to declare single combat on one foe within 50 ft: +1 on attack rolls and +1 dodge AC against that foe (only while no one else threatens it). If another combatant attacks you or that foe, the challenge ends and you tak

Charging Hurler.name: Charging Hurler: When making a thrown-weapon attack as a charge (end movement within 30 ft of the target): +2 on the attack roll and -2 to AC until the start of your next turn.

Cold Celerity.name: Cold Celerity: In severe cold (below 0F), or for 1 round after taking cold damage: +1 on attack rolls.

Death from Above.name: Death from Above: When you charge an opponent from higher ground, or from above while flying: +5 on attack rolls (in place of the charge and higher-ground bonuses).

Deathless Initiate.name: Deathless Initiate: While using the Diehard feat (i.e. at 0 or fewer hit points): +2 on melee attack rolls and +2 on melee damage rolls.

Demonic Nemesis.name: Demonic Nemesis: only against followers of your chosen demon lord (cultists or demons) - the damage and crit-confirmation bonuses are on the roll

Desperate Battler.name: Desperate Battler: When no ally is within 10 feet and you are not benefiting from aid another: +1 morale bonus on melee attack rolls and +1 morale bonus on melee damage rolls.

Disorienting Maneuver.name: Disorienting Maneuver: After tumbling through an opponent's space with Acrobatics, +2 circumstance on attack rolls vs that opponent (and +4 circumstance on a trip CMB) until your next turn.

Dog Killer, Horse Hunter.name: Dog Killer, Horse Hunter: +2 morale on all attack rolls against dogs and horses (and doglike/horselike creatures such as nightmares or worgs); also +2 to confirm crits vs them. +2 morale on all damage rolls against dogs and horses (and dogl

Dog-Sniff-Hate.name: Dog-Sniff-Hate: Against canines (dogs, goblin dogs, wolves, worgs, yeth hounds, etc.): +1 morale on attack rolls. Against canines (dogs, goblin dogs, wolves, worgs, yeth hounds, etc.): +2 morale on weapon damage rolls.

Exploit Lore.name: Exploit Lore: Once/day after a successful Knowledge check identifying a creature, +2 on attack rolls against that creature for 1 minute. Once/day after a successful Knowledge check identifying a creature, +2 on damage rolls against that cre

Fire Hand.name: Fire Hand: +1 on attack rolls with melee weapons that deal fire damage (e.g. a torch).

Focused Discipline.name: Focused Discipline: +2 morale on attack rolls, weapon damage, and CMB vs a creature whose fear effect you just resisted (1 round).

Giant Killer.name: Giant Killer: +2 circumstance on attack rolls for the extra cleave-style attacks made against humanoids (giant).

Gloom Strike.name: Gloom Strike: +1 on attack rolls against enemies in dim light or darkness, while you are also in dim light or darkness.

Gnome Weapon Focus.name: Gnome Weapon Focus: +1 on attack rolls with gnome weapons (weapons with 'gnome' in the name).

Goblin Cleaver.name: Goblin Cleaver: +2 circumstance on attack rolls for the extra Cleave/Great Cleave attacks made against humanoids (goblinoid).

Grudge Fighter.name: Grudge Fighter: +1 morale on attack and damage rolls against any creature that has attacked you in the current combat.

Halfling Slinger.name: Halfling Slinger: +1 racial bonus on attack rolls made using a sling.

Hard-Headed.name: Hard-Headed: +1 on attack rolls and combat maneuver checks made using a helmet (improvised weapon).

Horde Charge.name: Horde Charge: +2 on attack rolls when charging during the same round as an ally with this feat. +2 on damage rolls when charging during the same round as an ally with this feat (first attack only).

Improved Charging Hurler.name: Improved Charging Hurler: +2 on damage rolls when using Charging Hurler against a target within 30 feet.

Legacy of Ozem.name: Legacy of Ozem: +1 sacred bonus on weapon damage rolls when using good-aligned weapons (including those affected by bless weapon).

Liberator.name: Liberator: +1 bonus on attack rolls when your actions would directly lead to freeing prisoners or slaves. +1 bonus on weapon damage rolls when your actions would directly lead to freeing prisoners or slaves.

Mantis Wisdom.name: Mantis Wisdom: +2 bonus on unarmed attack rolls when using a Stunning Fist attempt while in Mantis Style.

Monkey Shine.name: Monkey Shine: +4 bonus on melee attack rolls against the opponent whose space you entered.

Moonlight Stalker.name: Moonlight Stalker: +2 bonus on attack rolls against an opponent you have concealment from. +2 bonus on damage rolls against an opponent you have concealment from.

Multiweapon Specialist.name: Multiweapon Specialist: +2 bonus on damage rolls when wielding a one-handed or light weapon in each arm with all weapons from the same fighter weapon group.

Net and Trident.name: Net and Trident: only when attacking an entangled opponent with your light or one-handed melee weapon (the damage and crit-confirmation bonuses are on the roll)

Nightmare Fist.name: Nightmare Fist: +2 bonus on damage rolls with unarmed strikes (or +4 vs shaken/frightened/panicked foes) while fighting within an area of magical darkness.

Orc Hewer.name: Orc Hewer: +2 circumstance bonus on attack rolls for Cleave/Great Cleave additional attacks against humanoids (orc).

Planar Hunter.name: Planar Hunter: +2 bonus on weapon attack rolls against outsiders native to a favored planar terrain (and identified extraplanar creatures from it); also ignore up to 5 points of DR against them.

Shamed.name: Shamed: +1 on attack rolls and skill checks while in a conflict observed by uninvolved others

Town Tamer.name: Town Tamer: In your chosen settlement: +1 on attack rolls and +2 on combat maneuver checks against undesirable elements (criminals/ruffians).

Twin Thunders Flurry.name: Twin Thunders Flurry: +2 on damage rolls against creatures of the giant subtype.

Vengeance.name: Vengeance: +1 on attack rolls against your chosen foe and its known minions. +1 on weapon damage rolls against your chosen foe and its known minions.

Adept Champion.name: Adept Champion: Activation: swift action at the start of your turn while using smite evil; Effect: forgo this attack's smite evil damage bonus to instead gain half that bonus on combat maneuver checks against the smite target until the start of your next turn

Ankle Biter.name: Ankle Biter: Activation: immediate action when you are the target of a combat maneuver, or swift action each round while grappled or pinned; Effect: bite the attacker for damage appropriate to your size (usually [[1d4]]) without provoking an attack of opportunity, and gain a bonus equal to the damage dealt on checks to break the grapple

Banishing Critical.name: Banishing Critical: Activation: on confirming a critical hit with a slashing or bludgeoning weapon; Save: target takes a -[[4]] penalty on its Will save; Effect: cast dismissal or banishment on the target as an immediate action

Beartrap Bite.name: Beartrap Bite: Activation: on confirming a critical hit with your bite attack if the confirmation roll meets or exceeds the target's CMD; Effect: clamp down on the target as a free action, preventing it from moving away until you release the bite as a swift action or it breaks free with a combat maneuver or Escape Artist check

Bewildering Koan.name: Bewildering Koan: Cost: [[1]] ki point; Activation: swift action, Bluff check vs the target; Effect: on a failed check, the target loses its next action, or you gain a bonus on damage rolls against it for [[1]] round

Bloody Assault.name: Bloody Assault: Effect: melee attacks and combat maneuver checks also deal [[1d4]] bleed damage

Bludgeoner.name: Bludgeoner: Effect: deal nonlethal damage with a bludgeoning weapon at no [[-4]] penalty

Boar Shred.name: Boar Shred: Effect: while using Boar Style, tearing an opponent's flesh also deals [[1d6]] bleed damage at the start of its turn

Boar Style.name: Boar Style: Effect: hitting a single foe with two or more unarmed strikes this round tears its flesh, dealing an additional [[2d6]] bleed damage once per round

Body Shield.name: Body Shield: Activation: immediate action while grappling an adjacent creature; Effect: make a grapple check to gain cover against a single attack; if that attack misses you, it instead strikes the grappled creature using the same attack roll

Bullying Blow.name: Bullying Blow: Effect: on damaging the target, make an Intimidate check to demoralize it as a free action

Butterfly's Sting.name: Butterfly's Sting: Effect: forgo this critical hit's extra damage; the next ally who hits the target with a melee attack before the start of your next turn automatically confirms a critical hit

Chainbreaker.name: Chainbreaker: Effect: bonus damage against an opponent known to own or trade in slaves, once per round

Chokehold.name: Chokehold: Effect: on a successful grapple check, pin the opponent in a chokehold that prevents breathing, speech, and verbal spellcasting until the grapple ends

Crane Riposte.name: Crane Riposte: Effect: fighting defensively costs only [[-1]] on attack rolls instead of the normal penalty; while fighting defensively, an attack you deflect with Crane Wing that misses provokes an attack of opportunity from you, and deflecting an attack with Crane Wing during total defense lets you make an attack of opportunity against that attacker

Crane Style.name: Crane Style: Effect: fighting defensively costs only [[-2]] on attack rolls instead of the normal penalty, and grants an additional +[[1]] dodge bonus to AC while fighting defensively or using total defense

Dauntless Destiny.name: Dauntless Destiny: Cost: [[1]]/day; Effect: reroll a natural [[1]] on a saving throw or attack roll; if the reroll succeeds, make an Intimidate check to demoralize the target as a free action

Dazing Assault.name: Dazing Assault: Save: Fortitude DC [[ 10 + @attributes.bab.total ]] negates; Effect: melee attacks also daze the target for [[1]] round

Death or Glory.name: Death or Glory: Effect: against a Large or larger creature, make a single attack as a full-round action with a +[[4]] bonus (+[[5]] at base attack bonus +[[11]], +[[6]] at +[[16]], +[[7]] at +[[20]]) on the attack roll, damage roll, and critical confirmation roll; the target may make a single melee attack against you with the same bonuses as an immediate action

Desperate Swing.name: Desperate Swing: Cost: [[1]]/day; Effect: make a single melee attack while taking the total defense action; the +[[4]] crit-confirmation bonus (on the roll) applies while fighting defensively or making an attack of opportunity

Destroyer's Blessing.name: Destroyer's Blessing: Effect: while raging, succeeding at a sunder combat maneuver regains [[1]] round of rage; if the sunder breaks the object, also heal [[1]] hit point (once per round)

Dimensional Maneuvers.name: Dimensional Maneuvers: Effect: while using Dimensional Dervish, bonus on combat maneuver checks to bull rush, disarm, reposition, or trip

Djinni Spin.name: Djinni Spin: Cost: [[2]] Elemental Fist attempts; Activation: standard action while using Djinni Style; Save: Fortitude DC [[ 10 + floor(@attributes.hd.total/2) + @abilities.wis.mod ]] halves damage and negates deafened; Effect: adjacent creatures take your unarmed strike damage plus Elemental Fist electricity damage and are deafened for [[1d4]] rounds

Draconic Breath.name: Draconic Breath: Cost: [[1]]/day; Activation: standard action, does not provoke attacks of opportunity; Save: Reflex DC [[ 10 + @attributes.hd.total + @abilities.con.mod ]] halves; Effect: breath weapon deals [[2d6]] damage of your scale's energy type in a line or cone (per Draconic Aspect or dragon-scaled trait color)

Dragon Ferocity.name: Dragon Ferocity: Effect: while using Dragon Style, on a critical hit or a successful Stunning Fist attempt, the target is also shaken for [[1d4]] rounds plus your Strength bonus

Dragon Roar.name: Dragon Roar: Cost: [[2]] Stunning Fist attempts; Activation: standard action; Range: [[15]]-foot cone; Save: Will DC [[ 10 + floor(@attributes.hd.total/2) + @abilities.wis.mod ]] half damage and negates shaken; Effect: deals your unarmed strike damage and shakens targets for [[1d4]] rounds

Dragon Style.name: Dragon Style: Effect: add half your Strength bonus to unarmed strike damage on your first unarmed strike each round

Earth Child Style.name: Earth Child Style: Effect: add your Wisdom bonus to unarmed strike damage against creatures of the giant subtype

Earth Child Topple.name: Earth Child Topple: Effect: while using Earth Child Style against creatures of the giant subtype, add your Wisdom bonus to critical hit confirmation rolls (on the roll) and to trip combat maneuver checks (apply the trip bonus manually)

Efreeti Style.name: Efreeti Style: Effect: add your Wisdom bonus to Elemental Fist fire damage; if the attack misses, still deal [[1d6]] fire damage

Elemental Fist.name: Elemental Fist: Activation: declare before the attack roll; Effect: on a hit, deal an extra [[1d6]] damage of the chosen energy type (acid, cold, electricity, or fire)

Fearless Zeal.name: Fearless Zeal: Cost: [[1]]/day; Activation: applied after the attack roll but before the result is known; Effect: +[[2]] bonus to the attack roll (+[[4]] at [[10]] or more Hit Dice)

Felling Smash.name: Felling Smash: Cost: swift action; Activation: after hitting with a single attack while using Power Attack; Effect: attempt a free trip combat maneuver against that opponent

Flaying Critical.name: Flaying Critical: Effect: on a critical hit, reduce the target's natural armor bonus by [[1]] (cumulative, minimum [[0]]) for the encounter

Flensing Strike.name: Flensing Strike: Effect: if the sneak attack causes bleed damage, the target is sickened and its natural armor bonus is reduced by an amount equal to your sneak attack dice for as long as the bleed persists (cumulative, up to the target's full natural armor)

Footslasher.name: Footslasher: Activation: standard action only, requires a piercing or slashing weapon against a larger foe; Effect: on a hit dealing at least [[1]] point of damage, halve the target's speed for [[24]] hours until treated with a DC [[15]] Heal check or magical healing

Furious Focus.name: Furious Focus: Effect: negate the Power Attack penalty on your first attack this turn (requires a two-handed weapon or two hands on a one-handed weapon)

Gore Fiend.name: Gore Fiend: Effect: while raging, regain [[1]] round of rage when you confirm a critical hit with a melee weapon or an enemy confirms a critical hit against you (once per round)

Greater Whip Mastery.name: Greater Whip Mastery: Effect: while grappling with your whip, deal your whip's weapon damage instead of unarmed strike damage; attempting to tie up a foe you have grappled (not pinned) takes only a [[-5]] penalty instead of the normal [[-10]]

Hamatula Grasp.name: Hamatula Grasp: Effect: attempt a grapple combat maneuver against an impaled opponent using the impaling weapon at only a [[-2]] penalty; on a success, deal an extra [[1d6]] damage

Hammer the Gap.name: Hammer the Gap: Effect: each consecutive hit against the same target this turn deals extra damage equal to the number of prior consecutive hits you have made against it this turn (multiplied on a critical hit); apply manually per attack

Harrowed.name: Harrowed: Cost: [[1]]/day (Harrow card draw); Activation: applied after the roll but before the result is known; Effect: +[[2]] bonus to the attack roll if the drawn card's suit matches

Hold the Blade.name: Hold the Blade: Cost: -[[4]] AC until your next turn; Activation: immediate action when a flanking or sneak attack melee hit damages you (once per round); Effect: attempt a disarm combat maneuver check against that attacker

Impaling Critical.name: Impaling Critical: Effect: on a critical hit with the selected piercing weapon, impale the target; each round it takes damage equal to your weapon's damage dice plus extra dice from weapon properties until the weapon is removed

Improved Impaling Critical.name: Improved Impaling Critical: Effect: while impaling a foe with Impaling Critical, it must succeed at a grapple check (or spend a standard action if you have let go) to remove the weapon; until removed its speed is halved and maneuverability drops one step; when finally removed you may instead deal bleed damage equal to your weapon's damage dice once per round

Improved Low Blow.name: Improved Low Blow: Cost: [[1]]/day (reroll only); Effect: applies against larger opponents; once per day, reroll a failed confirmation roll and take the new result

Improved Underhanded Teamwork.name: Improved Underhanded Teamwork: Activation: immediate action when an ally with this feat performs a dirty trick maneuver against a foe you both threaten; Effect: attempt your own dirty trick combat maneuver against the same foe to inflict a second condition (removing the first condition also removes this one)

Janni Rush.name: Janni Rush: Activation: jump as part of a charge, then hit with an unarmed strike against the designated target; Effect: roll your unarmed strike's damage dice twice and add the results together before Strength and precision bonuses; the extra dice are not multiplied on a critical hit

Ki Diversity.name: Ki Diversity: Cost: [[1]] ki point; Activation: swift action; Effect: choose a learned ki power - Bone Crusher (on a successful trip or disarm, deal unarmed strike damage), Dim Mak (your next Stunning Fist attempt is a melee touch attack), Mind of the Kensai (imbue a wielded weapon with the ki focus weapon special ability until your next turn), Wings of the Crane (deflect or catch a second missile weapon this round), or Zen Combatant (substitute Wisdom for Strength or Dexterity on melee or ranged attacks this round)

Marid Spirit.name: Marid Spirit: Save: Fortitude DC [[ 10 + floor(@attributes.hd.total/2) + @abilities.wis.mod ]] negates; Effect: while using Marid Style, a target damaged by cold from your Elemental Fist becomes entangled in ice for [[1d4]] rounds (the ice has hit points equal to [[3]] times your base attack bonus and a break DC of [[15]] plus your base attack bonus)

Marid Style.name: Marid Style: Effect: add your Wisdom bonus to cold damage dealt by Elemental Fist, and your unarmed strike reach increases by [[5]] feet

Merciful Bane.name: Merciful Bane: Cost: swift action; Effect: deal nonlethal damage with your bane weapon at no [[-4]] penalty

Monkey Style.name: Monkey Style: Effect: while prone, take no penalty on melee attack rolls or to AC; stand up without provoking attacks of opportunity, or as a swift action with a DC [[20]] Acrobatics check

Mounted Blade.name: Mounted Blade: Effect: after your Ride-By Attack hits, make an additional attack against a target adjacent to the original at a penalty

Neckbreaker.name: Neckbreaker: Effect: attempt a Stunning Fist against a helpless or pinned opponent your size or smaller at a penalty; on a success, wrench its neck for [[2d6]] Strength or Dexterity damage (excess damage bleeds into Constitution once the targeted score reaches [[0]]); creatures immune to critical hits or lacking a discernible head and neck are immune

Object Of Legend.name: Object Of Legend: Cost: [[1]] use per day; Activation: announce after threatening a critical hit, before the confirmation roll; Effect: applies only against a foe who specifically aims to stop you from completing your quest; does not stack with other confirmation-roll bonuses such as Critical Focus

Panther Parry.name: Panther Parry: Effect: while using Panther Style, this retaliatory unarmed strike resolves before the triggering attack of opportunity; if it deals damage, that triggering attack takes a [[-2]] penalty on its attack and damage rolls

Patient Strike.name: Patient Strike: Activation: ready this attack as a full-round action instead of a standard action; Effect: gain a bonus on the attack roll when the readied action triggers

Perfect Strike.name: Perfect Strike: Cost: [[1]] use per day per [[4]] character levels, no more than once per round, weapon must be a kama, nunchaku, quarterstaff, sai, or siangham; Activation: declare before making the attack roll (a failed attack roll ruins the attempt); Effect: roll the attack roll twice and take the higher result (a threat on either roll can serve as the confirmation roll for the other, your choice if both are threats)

Planar Wild Shape.name: Planar Wild Shape: Cost: an additional daily use of wild shape, to add the celestial or fiendish template to your animal form (good druids must use celestial, evil druids fiendish); Effect: applies on a critical threat with your form's natural weapons against an evil creature (celestial template) or a good creature (fiendish template)

Punishing Kick.name: Punishing Kick: Cost: [[1]] use per day per [[4]] character levels, no more than once per round; Activation: declare before making the attack roll (a failed attack roll ruins the attempt); Save: Fortitude DC [[10 + floor(@attributes.hd.total/2) + @abilities.wis.mod]] negates being knocked prone; Effect: on a hit, push the target [[5]] feet directly away, or attempt to knock it prone instead (it must end the push in a safe space and this movement does not provoke)

Pushing Assault.name: Pushing Assault: Activation: choose after the attack roll, before damage is rolled; Effect: on a hit against a creature your size or smaller with a two-handed Power Attack-modified attack, forgo the Power Attack damage bonus to instead push the target [[5]] feet directly away ([[10]] feet on a critical hit) into a safe space, without provoking

Raging Brutality.name: Raging Brutality: Cost: [[3]] additional rounds of rage as a swift action (requires raging and using Power Attack); Effect: add your Constitution modifier to melee or thrown-weapon damage rolls this turn ([[1.5]]x your Constitution modifier if wielding the weapon two-handed); this damage is not multiplied on a critical hit

Raging Deathblow.name: Raging Deathblow: Effect: while raging, reducing your opponent to [[-1]] or fewer hit points grants [[1]] extra round of rage for the day ([[1]] additional extra round if the attack was a critical hit); unused extra rounds are lost when you rest to renew your rage for the day

Raging Throw.name: Raging Throw: Cost: [[1]] additional round of rage as a swift action (requires raging); Effect: add your Constitution modifier to this bull rush combat maneuver check; if the target is pushed into another creature's space or a solid object, both take [[ @abilities.str.mod + @abilities.con.mod ]] bludgeoning damage

Rebuffing Reduction.name: Rebuffing Reduction: Activation: immediate action; Effect: when an adjacent opponent's melee attack fails to penetrate your damage reduction, attempt a bull rush combat maneuver against it; on a success you do not move along with the target

Reckless Aim.name: Reckless Aim: Cost: -[[1]] AC; Effect: gain a competence bonus on this ranged attack roll against a target engaged in melee; a natural [[1]] on this roll instead automatically hits a random adjacent creature that threatens the intended target

Redemption.name: Redemption: Cost: become shaken for [[1]] minute; Activation: immediate action, chosen before the result is revealed; Effect: gain a bonus on this attack roll you have just made

Rending Claws.name: Rending Claws: Cost: usable once per round, requires hitting with two claw attacks in the same turn; Effect: the second claw attack deals extra precision damage, not multiplied on a critical hit

Reverse-Feint.name: Reverse-Feint: Activation: move action; Effect: leave a gap in your defenses for one adjacent opponent, granting it a [[4]] bonus on its next attack against you; whether or not it hits, make an immediate action melee attack against it with a bonus on the attack roll

Ricochet Shot Deed.name: Ricochet Shot Deed: Cost: [[1]] grit point (optional, to ignore all cover and concealment on this shot; requires at least [[1]] grit point to attempt at all); Effect: fire at a wall or piece of solid terrain and have it ricochet, using the square immediately in front of it as the new origin square for line of sight and cover (and your own square for concealment)

Riptide Attack.name: Riptide Attack: Activation: swift action; Effect: after a successful trip combat maneuver, automatically make a drag combat maneuver against the same target using the trip check's base attack bonus (provokes attacks of opportunity as normal)

Saddle Shrieker.name: Saddle Shrieker: Cost: a penalty (starting at [[-1]], increasing by [[-1]] at base attack bonus +[[4]] and every [[4]] points thereafter, to a maximum of [[-5]]) on your attack rolls and combat maneuver checks; Activation: declare before making an attack roll; Effect: for [[1]] round, your mount gains an equal bonus (capped at +[[5]]) on its attack and damage rolls with natural weapons

Serpent Lash.name: Serpent Lash: Activation: standard action; Effect: make a disarm or trip maneuver with your whip; on a success, make an additional disarm or trip maneuver at the same bonus against a target adjacent to the first and within your whip's reach; you may also perform a reposition maneuver with your whip at a [[-4]] penalty on the CMB check, moving the target only toward you

Shaitan Style.name: Shaitan Style: Cost: gain [[1]] additional Elemental Fist use per day; Effect: while using Elemental Fist to deal acid damage, add your Wisdom modifier to the acid damage roll; if this Elemental Fist melee attack misses while dealing acid damage, you still deal [[1d6]] acid damage to the target

Shield Slam.name: Shield Slam: Effect: an opponent hit by this shield bash is also hit with a free bull rush combat maneuver, substituting this attack roll for the CMB check (no attack of opportunity); a target that cannot move back due to a wall or other surface is knocked prone instead once moved the maximum possible distance

Sleep Venom.name: Sleep Venom: Activation: swift action, decided before applying venom to a weapon; Effect: your venom's initial effect becomes staggered for [[1d4]] rounds and its secondary effect becomes unconsciousness for [[1]] minute

Sleeper Hold.name: Sleeper Hold: Cost: a [[2]] penalty to your AC while attempting this; Activation: declare before making the combat maneuver check to maintain the grapple (a failed check ruins the attempt); Save: Fortitude DC [[10 + floor(@attributes.hd.total/2) + @abilities.str.mod]] negates (cumulative [[1]] penalty on the save for each consecutive round attempted); Effect: after maintaining the grapple for consecutive rounds equal to the target's Constitution bonus (minimum [[1]]), it falls unconscious for [[1d4]] rounds on a failed save; creatures immune to bleed damage, stunning, or critical hits are immune

Sliding Axe Throw.name: Sliding Axe Throw: Cost: a penalty on this ranged attack roll with an axe; Effect: bounces or slides the axe along the ground; if the target is flat-footed, running, or charging, this attack ignores any bonus to its AC from a shield; on a hit, make a free trip attempt (a failed trip grants the target no trip attempt against you in return)

Snapping Turtle Clutch.name: Snapping Turtle Clutch: Activation: immediate action; Effect: while using Snapping Turtle Style, its shield bonus to AC also applies to your CMD and touch AC; when an opponent misses you with a melee attack, attempt a grapple combat maneuver against it at a penalty

Spiked Destroyer.name: Spiked Destroyer: Activation: swift action; Effect: after succeeding at a bull rush or overrun combat maneuver, make an attack roll with your armor spikes against the target, using your highest attack bonus

Stabbing Shot.name: Stabbing Shot: Cost: a penalty on all of this round's attack rolls (the melee attack and the ranged attacks); Effect: replace the extra attack from Rapid Shot with a melee attack against an adjacent opponent using a drawn arrow; a hit pushes the target [[5]] feet away, whether or not it deals damage, after which you may fire your remaining arrows at the original or another target without provoking if no enemy still threatens you

Stage Combatant.name: Stage Combatant: Effect: with a weapon you have Weapon Focus in, take no penalty on the attack roll when attempting to deal no damage or nonlethal damage

Steady Engagement.name: Steady Engagement: Activation: immediate action; Effect: after using Stand Still to prevent an opponent from moving, make a disarm or trip combat maneuver against it

Stunning Assault.name: Stunning Assault: Cost: a penalty on all melee attack rolls and combat maneuver checks until your next turn; Activation: declare before making the attack roll; Save: Fortitude DC [[10 + @attributes.bab.total]] negates; Effect: a target you hit is stunned for [[1]] round

Surge of Success.name: Surge of Success: Cost: expend the bonus gained by confirming a critical hit or rolling a natural [[20]] on a saving throw this round; Effect: +[[2]] circumstance bonus on this attack roll

Surprise Strike.name: Surprise Strike: Cost: [[1]]/day; Effect: no penalty on this attack roll while fighting defensively, or on an attack of opportunity taken during total defense with the Desperate Swing feat

Tiger Pounce.name: Tiger Pounce: Effect: while using Tiger Style, your Power Attack penalty applies to your AC instead of this attack roll (+[[1+floor(@attributes.bab.total/4)]] to offset it); after a hit or successful combat maneuver, you may move up to half your speed as a swift action once per round

Tiger Style.name: Tiger Style: Effect: on a critical hit with your slashing unarmed strike, the foe takes [[1d4]] bleed damage at the start of its next two turns

Touch of Serenity.name: Touch of Serenity: Cost: [[1]]/round, up to [[floor(@attributes.hd.total/4)]]/day; Effect: this hit deals no damage but the target cannot cast spells or attack for [[1]] round; Save: Will DC [[10+floor(@attributes.hd.total/2)+@abilities.wis.mod]] negates

Twin Thunders.name: Twin Thunders: Effect: once per round, vs a creature with the giant subtype, if you hit with this off-hand bludgeoning weapon after hitting with your primary weapon, roll this weapon's damage dice twice and add the results together before adding bonuses (the extra dice are not multiplied on a critical hit)

Whip-Slinger.name: Whip-Slinger: Effect: attack of opportunity with an unloaded sling, double sling, or halfling sling staff takes a -[[4]] penalty on this attack roll

Wolf Savage.name: Wolf Savage: Cost: swift action; Effect: if this hit deals at least [[10]] damage to a prone foe with a natural weapon or unarmed strike, the target becomes disfigured as bestow curse (caster level = your character level); Save: Fortitude DC [[10+floor(@attributes.hd.total/2)+@abilities.wis.mod]] negates

Wolf Style.name: Wolf Style: Effect: an attack of opportunity that deals at least [[10]] damage reduces the foe's base speed by [[5]] ft (+[[5]] ft for every additional [[5]] damage) for [[1]] round; if this meets or exceeds its remaining movement, you may attempt a free trip combat maneuver check

Wolf Trip.name: Wolf Trip: Effect: +[[2]] bonus on this trip combat maneuver check made as an attack of opportunity; while using Wolf Style, on a successful trip you may choose an adjacent square for the foe to land in as a free action

Bashing Finish.name: Bashing Finish: Activation: On a confirmed critical hit with a melee weapon; Effect: make a free shield bash attack against the same target using this attack's bonus

Belier's Bite.name: Belier's Bite: Effect: damaging an opponent with an unarmed strike deals an additional [[1d4]] bleed damage

Binding Throw.name: Binding Throw: Activation: Swift action after a successful use of Ki Throw against this opponent; Effect: attempt a grapple combat maneuver check against the same opponent

Blinding Sneak Attack.name: Blinding Sneak Attack: Save: Fortitude DC [[10]] + sneak attack damage dealt negates; Effect: dealing sneak attack damage while within an area of magical darkness blinds the target for [[1]] round

Blood Beak.name: Blood Beak: Effect: on a confirmed critical hit with your beak attack, deal an additional [[1]] point of bleed damage

Bloodletting.name: Bloodletting: Effect: threatening a critical hit with a piercing or slashing weapon, confirmed or not, causes the target to bleed for [[1]] point at the start of each of its turns thereafter

Bodyguard.name: Bodyguard: Activation: Use an attack of opportunity when an adjacent ally is attacked; Effect: attempt the aid another action to improve that ally's AC instead of dealing damage (cannot be used to aid the ally's attack roll)

Bonebreaker.name: Bonebreaker: Effect: against a grappled, helpless, or stunned foe, forgo your Stunning Fist effect to instead deal [[1d6]] Strength or Dexterity damage

Broken Wing Gambit.name: Broken Wing Gambit: Effect: hitting with a melee attack grants the target a +[[2]] bonus on attack and damage rolls against you until the end of your next turn or until it attacks you, whichever comes first; if it attacks you, this provokes attacks of opportunity from allies who also have this feat

Brutal Grappler.name: Brutal Grappler: Effect: aiding an ally with this feat in the same grapple grants a bonus on your grapple combat maneuver check

Bull Rush Strike.name: Bull Rush Strike: Effect: on a confirmed critical hit with a melee attack, if the confirmation roll exceeds the target's CMD, push it back as if from a successful bull rush without provoking an attack of opportunity

Bullseye Shot.name: Bullseye Shot: Activation: Move action to steady your shot; Effect: gain a bonus on your next ranged attack roll before the end of your turn

Burn! Burn! Burn!.name: Burn! Burn! Burn!: Effect: extra fire damage when attacking with a nonmagical or alchemical fire source, such as alchemical fire or a torch (does not apply to magical attacks or splash damage)

Cockatrice Strike.name: Cockatrice Strike: Activation: Full-round action; a single unarmed strike against a dazed, flat-footed, paralyzed, staggered, stunned, or unconscious foe; Save: Fortitude DC [[ 10 + floor(@attributes.hd.total/2) + @abilities.wis.mod ]] negates; Effect: on a critical hit, the target is petrified

Combat Meditation.name: Combat Meditation: Cost: [[1]] of your daily uses (usable [[@abilities.wis.mod]] times per day); Activation: Expend the insight bonus from Meditation Master instead of applying it normally; Effect: roll this attack twice and take the higher result

Coordinated Maneuvers.name: Coordinated Maneuvers: Effect: being adjacent to an ally with this feat grants a competence bonus on combat maneuver checks (increases to +[[4]] when attempting to break free from a grapple)

Crippling Critical.name: Crippling Critical: Save: Fortitude DC [[ 10 + @attributes.bab.total ]] reduces the duration to [[1d4]] rounds; Effect: on a critical hit, the target's speed is halved for [[1]] minute (a flying target must succeed at a DC [[10]] Fly check to remain airborne and its maneuverability is reduced by one step)

Crusader's Fist.name: Crusader's Fist: Cost: [[1]] swift action and [[1]] daily use of lay on hands or touch of corruption; Activation: this attack is an unarmed strike that hits a creature you could target with that feature; Effect: deal that feature's normal damage as if delivered by its touch attack (not multiplied on a critical hit).

Deadly Finish.name: Deadly Finish: Activation: this melee attack reduces the target to -[[1]] hp or fewer; Save: target Fortitude DC [[15]] + damage dealt or die.

Dervish Dance.name: Dervish Dance: Effect: use your Dexterity modifier instead of your Strength modifier on this attack and damage roll (scimitar wielded one-handed, sized for you, no weapon or shield in your off hand).

Destroy Identity.name: Destroy Identity: Effect: on a critical hit, the target takes [[2]] Charisma damage and is staggered for [[1]] round.

Devastating Strike.name: Devastating Strike: Effect: while using Vital Strike, Improved Vital Strike, or Greater Vital Strike, gain a +[[2]] bonus (multiplied on a critical hit) on each extra weapon damage die those feats grant, to a maximum of +[[6]].

Dirty Trick Master.name: Dirty Trick Master: Effect: if this dirty trick combat maneuver succeeds against a target still affected by a condition from a previous dirty trick, worsen that condition (dazzled becomes dazed, entangled becomes pinned, shaken becomes frightened, sickened becomes nauseated) for the dirty trick's duration, replacing the prior condition.

Disarming Strike.name: Disarming Strike: Activation: this melee attack is a critical hit and your confirmation roll exceeds the target's CMD; Effect: disarm the target as the disarm combat maneuver (no attack of opportunity).

Discordant Voice.name: Discordant Voice: Activation: you are using bardic performance to create a spell-like or supernatural effect and the target is within [[30]] feet of you; Effect: this attack deals extra sonic damage, stacking with other energy damage.

Disorienting Blow.name: Disorienting Blow: Cost: use of Stunning Fist, chosen before the attack roll, replacing Stunning Fist's normal effect; Activation: this hit is a Stunning Fist attempt; Save: target Fortitude save (Stunning Fist DC) or become confused for [[1]] round (additional disorienting blows against a confused target add to the duration).

Dispelling Critical.name: Dispelling Critical: Cost: [[1]] swift action and your prepared or spontaneous dispel magic; Activation: this attack scores a critical hit; Effect: cast dispel magic as a targeted dispel against the target.

Disposable Weapon.name: Disposable Weapon: Cost: give your fragile weapon the broken condition; Activation: this attack scores a critical threat with a fragile melee or thrown weapon; Effect: automatically confirm the critical hit.

Dragonslayer.name: Dragonslayer: Cost: forgo the extra critical hit damage; Activation: you confirm a critical hit against a creature with a breath weapon; Effect: prevent the target from using its breath weapon for [[2]] × your weapon's critical multiplier rounds, in addition to any normal breath weapon delay.

Enforcer.name: Enforcer: Activation: you deal nonlethal damage with this melee weapon; Effect: free action Intimidate check to demoralize; on success the target is shaken for a number of rounds equal to the damage dealt; on a critical hit, a successful check instead frightens the target for [[1]] round in addition to being shaken for the same duration.

Felling Escape.name: Felling Escape: Cost: [[1]] swift action; Activation: you break an opponent's grapple with a combat maneuver check or Escape Artist check; Effect: make a trip attempt against that opponent.

Flagbearer.name: Flagbearer: Effect: while you hold your clan, house, or party's flag in one hand, you and allies within [[30]] feet who can see it gain a morale bonus on attack and damage rolls (and on saves vs. fear/charm); if the flag is lost or destroyed, this becomes a penalty instead for [[1]] hour or until reclaimed.

Flanking Foil.name: Flanking Foil: Effect: until the start of your next turn, this target loses its flanking bonus on attack rolls against you and cannot deal sneak attack damage to you (it can still flank for its allies).

Focused Shot.name: Focused Shot: Activation: standard action attack with a bow or crossbow, target within [[30]] feet; Effect: add your Intelligence modifier to the damage roll (no effect against creatures immune to critical hits and sneak attacks).

Foment the Blood.name: Foment the Blood: Cost: a use of channel energy, forgoing its normal heal/harm effect on other creatures; Effect: orcs, yourself included, gain a bonus on weapon damage and critical hit confirmation rolls until your next turn, equal to the number of dice your channeled energy normally heals or harms.

Fury's Fall.name: Fury's Fall: Effect: add your Dexterity modifier to your CMB for this trip attempt.

Greater Rending Fury.name: Greater Rending Fury: Effect: rend deals an extra [[1d6]] bleed damage

Greater Snap Shot.name: Greater Snap Shot: Activation: ranged attack of opportunity; the damage and crit-confirmation bonuses rise at base attack bonus [[16]] and [[20]]

Hamatulatsu.name: Hamatulatsu: Effect: on a critical hit while dealing piercing damage with an unarmed strike, the target is sickened for [[1]] round (staggered for [[1]] round if already sickened)

Haunted Gnome Assault.name: Haunted Gnome Assault: Effect: while under haunted fey aspect, discharge it as a free action after a charge hit or critical hit to make the target shaken for [[1]] round

Horn Of The Criosphinx.name: Horn Of The Criosphinx: Effect: on a successful charge attack with a two-handed weapon in both hands, add an extra [[2]]x Strength bonus to the damage roll

Iconoclast.name: Iconoclast: Effect: after successfully sundering a holy or unholy symbol, make a free Intimidate check to demoralize all followers within [[30]] ft. who saw it (+[[5]] if you destroyed the symbol)

Impact Critical Shot.name: Impact Critical Shot: Effect: on a confirmed critical hit with a ranged weapon, if the confirmation roll exceeds the target's CMD you may bull rush or trip it as part of the attack without provoking an attack of opportunity

Improved Bull Rush.name: Improved Bull Rush: Effect: +[[2]] bull rush CMB (no attack of opportunity)

Improved Drag.name: Improved Drag: Effect: +[[2]] drag CMB (no attack of opportunity)

Improved Grapple.name: Improved Grapple: Effect: +[[2]] grapple CMB (no attack of opportunity)

Improved Ki Throw.name: Improved Ki Throw: Effect: -[[4]] penalty on the secondary bull rush check to throw the target into an occupied square (-[[4]] additional per extra secondary target for Large+ creatures); on success the thrown creature lands prone in the secondary target's square and the secondary target is pushed back and knocked prone

Improved Overrun.name: Improved Overrun: Effect: +[[2]] overrun CMB (no attack of opportunity; target can't choose to avoid you)

Improved Rending Fury.name: Improved Rending Fury: Effect: rend deals an extra [[1d6]] damage, not multiplied on a critical hit

Improved Reposition.name: Improved Reposition: Effect: +[[2]] reposition CMB (no attack of opportunity)

Improved Sunder.name: Improved Sunder: Effect: +[[2]] sunder CMB (no attack of opportunity)

Inner Flame.name: Inner Flame: Effect: while Scorching Weapons is active, the affected weapon deals [[1d6]] fire damage instead of [[1]] (also dealt to a grappled opponent on your turn)

Innocent Blood.name: Innocent Blood: Effect: after slaying an intelligent creature, +[[1]] bonus on attack rolls (and caster level checks) for [[1]] minute (does not stack with itself)

Intimidating Confidence.name: Intimidating Confidence: Effect: on a confirmed critical hit, make a free Intimidate check to demoralize a threatened creature (all threatened creatures if you have Dazzling Display); +[[2]] on that check if your weapon's critical multiplier is x3, +[[4]] if x4

Janni Tempest.name: Janni Tempest: Activation: while using Janni Style, after hitting with an unarmed strike; Effect: +[[4]] bonus on your next bull rush or trip combat maneuver check this turn (no attack of opportunity)

Jawbreaker.name: Jawbreaker: Effect: a successful Stunning Fist against a grappled, helpless, or stunned foe instead deals normal unarmed damage plus [[1d4]] bleed damage and disables the target's mouth (no speech or verbal components) until the bleed ends

Kobold Style.name: Kobold Style: +[[4]] bonus on combat maneuver checks against foes denied their Dexterity bonus to AC

Large Target.name: Large Target: Effect: sling damage +[[1]] per size category the target is larger than you; precision damage, not multiplied on a critical hit

Lucky Strike.name: Lucky Strike: Cost: [[1]] use of adaptive luck; Effect: reroll this attack's damage and take the better of the two results

Manyshot.name: Manyshot: Effect: full attack with a bow only; your first attack fires two arrows and both hit if the attack hits; apply precision damage (such as sneak attack) and critical hit damage only once for the attack, while other damage bonuses (Strength, favored enemy, etc.) apply separately to each arrow

Merciless Precision.name: Merciless Precision: Effect: sneak attack damage +[[1]]d6 against a target already blinded, dying, entangled, exhausted, frightened, helpless, nauseated, panicked, paralyzed, or stunned

Murderer's Circle.name: Murderer's Circle: Activation: as a swift action after scoring a critical hit or performing a combat maneuver while adjacent to the target; Effect: move to another space adjacent to the target without provoking attacks of opportunity; if you end the move in a different space, +[[2]] on the performance combat check

Net Trickery.name: Net Trickery: Effect: a melee attack with your net can instead attempt a dirty trick maneuver to blind, or (against a foe already entangled in your net) a trip maneuver; +[[2]] bonus on drag and reposition combat maneuver checks made with your net

Nightmare Striker.name: Nightmare Striker: Save: DC +[[2]] to resist this Stunning Fist attempt while the target is outlined by your faerie fire; Effect: if the target fails its save, it also becomes shaken for [[1]]d2 rounds plus [[1]] round for every [[5]] points it failed the save by

Opening Volley.name: Opening Volley: Effect: +[[4]] circumstance bonus on the next melee attack roll against a foe you hit with a ranged attack this turn (must be made before the end of your next turn)

Outflank.name: Outflank: Effect: while you and an ally who also has Outflank are flanking the same creature, your flanking bonus increases by +[[2]] (to +[[4]] total); a critical hit you score against the flanked creature provokes an attack of opportunity from that ally

Pinning Knockout.name: Pinning Knockout: Effect: while you have the opponent pinned, a successful grapple check to deal nonlethal damage with an unarmed strike or a light or one-handed weapon doubles the damage result; creatures immune to critical hits are immune to this effect

Pinning Rend.name: Pinning Rend: Effect: while you have the opponent pinned, a successful grapple check to deal damage with an unarmed strike or a light or one-handed weapon also causes bleed damage equal to that weapon's damage dice; creatures immune to critical hits are immune to this effect

Porcupine Defense.name: Porcupine Defense: Effect: +[[2]] bonus on an attack of opportunity you make against a larger foe's combat maneuver attempt against you (or +[[2]] CMD instead, if that maneuver doesn't provoke)

Quivering Palm Versatility.name: Quivering Palm Versatility: Activation: choose the desired effect before making the quivering palm attack roll; Effect: instead of killing, on a failed Fortitude save the target falls into a coma for [[1]] day per monk level, or loses [[1]] day per monk level of memories, or takes [[1]]d6 nonlethal damage per monk level, as chosen; otherwise subject to all normal quivering palm limits

Radiant Charge.name: Radiant Charge: Cost: expend all remaining uses of lay on hands; Activation: on a successful charge attack; Effect: deal extra holy damage equal to [[1]]d6 per use of lay on hands expended plus your Charisma bonus, not subject to damage reduction, energy immunity, or energy resistance

Rapid Shot.name: Rapid Shot: -[[2]] penalty on all your attack rolls this round in exchange for one additional ranged attack at your highest attack bonus (full-attack action only)

Ricochet Splash Weapon.name: Ricochet Splash Weapon: Activation: your splash weapon misses and the misdirection roll lands in a square occupied by a creature; Effect: make an attack roll against that creature at a [[-5]] penalty; on a hit it takes full damage instead of splash damage (adjacent squares still take splash damage as normal)

Shapeshifter Foil.name: Shapeshifter Foil: Save: Will DC [[10+floor(@attributes.hd.total/2)+@abilities.wis.mod]] negates being forced back into its original form (no save allowed if this is a critical hit); Effect: damaging a creature under a polymorph effect also forces a concentration check (DC [[15]] plus twice the effect's level) to use or maintain that polymorph effect until the end of your next turn

Sneaking Precision.name: Sneaking Precision: Cost: swift action; Activation: you sneak attack the same opponent a second time on your turn; Effect: apply the effects of one critical feat you know to that opponent, as though you had just confirmed a critical hit against it

Solo Maneuvers.name: Solo Maneuvers: Effect: +[[1]] bonus on combat maneuver checks against an opponent only you threaten (also +[[1]] to your CMD against that opponent's maneuvers, not reflected here)

Splintering Weapon.name: Splintering Weapon: Cost: give your fragile/primitive weapon the broken condition; Effect: on a hit, deal the target an additional [[1]]d4 bleed damage

Sundering Strike.name: Sundering Strike: Effect: when you score a critical hit with a melee attack, if your critical confirmation roll exceeds the target's CMD, you also sunder its weapon as the sunder combat maneuver (roll weapon damage separately); this does not provoke an attack of opportunity

Sunlit Strike.name: Sunlit Strike: Save: Fortitude DC [[10+@attributes.hd.total+@abilities.str.mod]] negates being staggered for [[1]] round; Effect: melee hit with an Arcane Strike-imbued weapon against a creature vulnerable to light deals an additional [[1]]d6 damage

Swarm Strike.name: Swarm Strike: Effect: +[[1]] bonus on your attack of opportunity against a foe that provokes it, plus an additional +[[1]] for each ally who also has this feat and currently threatens that foe (add manually per ally)

Tandem Trip.name: Tandem Trip: Effect: roll this trip combat maneuver check twice and take the better result (the foe must be threatened by an ally who also has this feat)

Topple Foe.name: Topple Foe: Effect: +[[1]] bonus on this trip CMB check against a foe larger than you while an ally with Topple Foe also flanks it (stacks with Improved/Greater Trip); +[[2]] more per additional ally flanking; the per-ally bonus grows by +[[1]] each consecutive round you trip the same foe, to a maximum of +[[4]] per ally on the 4th round

Tripping Strike.name: Tripping Strike: Effect: on a critical hit with a melee attack, attempt to trip the target as well; if your confirmation roll exceeds its CMD it falls prone, with no attack of opportunity

Tripping Twirl.name: Tripping Twirl: Activation: full-round action while wielding a quarterstaff two-handed; Effect: attempt a trip combat maneuver against each enemy adjacent to you

Two-Handed Thrower.name: Two-Handed Thrower: Effect: throwing a one-handed or two-handed weapon with both hands grants a damage bonus of [[1.5]]x your Strength bonus (replaces the normal single Strength bonus for a thrown weapon)

Two-Weapon Rend.name: Two-Weapon Rend: Effect: after hitting with both your primary and off-hand weapon this round, deal an extra [[1]]d10 damage plus [[1]].5x your Strength modifier (once per round)

Undermining Exploit.name: Undermining Exploit: Effect: +[[4]] insight bonus on combat maneuver checks against foes in rocky, difficult terrain

Whirlwind Attack.name: Whirlwind Attack: Activation: full-attack action; Effect: give up your regular attacks to make one melee attack at your highest base attack bonus against each opponent within reach (forfeits bonus or extra attacks from other feats, spells, or abilities)

Wingclipper.name: Wingclipper: Effect: on a confirmed critical hit against a foe that flies using wings, forgo the extra critical damage to instead ground it for a number of rounds equal to twice your weapon's critical multiplier; a target that was flying must succeed at a DC [[20]] Fly check or take falling damage

Vital Strike.name: Vital Strike: Activation: attack action (single attack); Effect: roll the weapon's damage dice twice, extra dice not multiplied on a critical hit

Improved Vital Strike.name: Improved Vital Strike: Activation: attack action (single attack); Effect: roll the weapon's damage dice three times, extra dice not multiplied on a critical hit

Greater Vital Strike.name: Greater Vital Strike: Activation: attack action (single attack); Effect: roll the weapon's damage dice four times, extra dice not multiplied on a critical hit

Point-Blank Shot.name: Point-Blank Shot: +1 attack and damage with ranged weapons within 30 ft

Precise Shot.name: Precise Shot: Effect: no -4 penalty when firing a ranged weapon into melee

Improved Precise Shot.name: Improved Precise Shot: Effect: ranged attacks ignore the AC bonus from anything less than total cover and the miss chance from anything less than total concealment

Far Shot.name: Far Shot: Effect: only -1 per full range increment (instead of -2) with ranged weapons

Arcane Strike.name: Arcane Strike: Activation: swift action; Effect: +[[max(1, floor(@spells.primary.cl.total / 5))]] damage and weapons count as magic for 1 round

Sap Adept.name: Sap Adept: Effect: when dealing nonlethal sneak attack damage with a bludgeoning weapon, add +damage equal to the number of sneak attack dice rolled

Sap Master.name: Sap Master: Effect: when dealing nonlethal sneak attack damage with a bludgeoning weapon to a flat-footed opponent, roll sneak attack dice twice

Deadly Stroke.name: Deadly Stroke: Activation: standard action, single attack with your Greater Weapon Focus weapon vs a stunned or flat-footed opponent; Effect: double damage plus 1 Con bleed (not multiplied on a crit)

Dirty Fighting.name: Dirty Fighting: Effect: on a combat maneuver against a foe you flank, trade the +2 flanking bonus for not provoking an AoO (or keep provoking-immunity and take +4 instead)

Spirited Charge.name: Spirited Charge: Activation: mounted charge; Effect: melee weapon deals double damage (x3 with a lance)

Ride-By Attack.name: Ride-By Attack: Activation: mounted charge; Effect: move, attack at any point during the movement, then keep moving (no AoO from the target)

Charge Through.name: Charge Through: Effect: while charging, attempt one free overrun against a creature in the path; success lets the charge continue

Rhino Charge.name: Rhino Charge: Effect: you may ready a charge, moving up to your speed

Archon Style.name: Archon Style: Activation: move action; Effect: adjacent allies gain +2 dodge AC vs one threatened foe's next melee attack until your next turn; you take -2 AC vs that foe

Archon Diversion.name: Archon Diversion: Effect: Archon Style's AC penalty drops to -1; once/round, divert one melee attack targeting an adjacent ally to yourself (free); the ally then gets an AoO against the diverted foe

Archon Justice.name: Archon Justice: Effect: no AC penalty for Archon Style, usable as a swift or move action; when Archon Diversion redirects damage to you, each ally threatening the attacker gets an AoO against it

Ascetic Style.name: Ascetic Style: Effect: apply Improved-Unarmed-Strike-dependent feats/effects to attacks made with your chosen monk weapon group weapon

Ascetic Form.name: Ascetic Form: Effect: use chosen weapon with unarmed-strike-only class abilities; counts as monk level = character level for monk-level-based feat uses/day

Ascetic Strike.name: Ascetic Strike: Effect: use the unarmed strike damage of a monk 4 levels lower (min 1st) instead of chosen weapon's base damage

Asura Style.name: Asura Style: Effect: monk weapon/unarmed hit on a divine spellcaster sickens it for [[1d4]] rounds (Fort DC [[10 + floor(@attributes.hd.total/2) + @abilities.wis.mod]] reduces to 1 round)

Asura Sight.name: Asura Sight: Effect: while using Asura Style, gain improved uncanny dodge as a rogue of your character level

Asura Spellrend.name: Asura Spellrend: Effect: replace your highest-BAB attack with a no-damage spellrending strike; on a hit, attempt dispel magic vs a harmless divine spell (success also sickens, no save)

Azata Style.name: Azata Style: Effect: moving [[15]]+ ft this round grants +[[1]] dodge AC until the start of your next turn

Azata Mischief.name: Azata Mischief: Effect: when a foe misses you with a movement-provoked AoO, attempt a free trip vs it (swift action, no AoO) if still adjacent

Azata Sprint.name: Azata Sprint: Effect: while using Azata Style, +[[10]] ft base speed; ignore movement penalty from the first [[10]] ft of difficult terrain moved through

Barracuda Style.name: Barracuda Style: Effect: no underwater penalty on unarmed attack rolls/damage; add Wis mod to Swim checks

Barracuda Slam.name: Barracuda Slam: Effect: on a charge (land or water), first unarmed strike gains an extra +[[@abilities.str.mod]] dmg (doubles Str bonus)

Barracuda Dash.name: Barracuda Dash: Effect: swim speed = base speed; a hit on a charge lets you immediately charge a second foe (no pounce stacking)

Beastmaster Style.name: Beastmaster Style: Activation: immediate action; Effect: Handle Animal check vs attacker's roll negates a hit on your adjacent animal companion

Beastmaster Salvation.name: Beastmaster Salvation: Activation: immediate action; Effect: substitute a Handle Animal check for your adjacent animal companion's saving throw

Beastmaster Ire.name: Beastmaster Ire: Effect: on activating Beastmaster Style, gain +2 melee attack/+4 dmg (+4/+8 if the attack damaged your companion) vs the attacker until end of next turn

Blinded Blade Style.name: Blinded Blade Style: Effect: while blinded/unable to see, no Str/Dex skill penalty from blindness; +4 hearing/smell Perception; gain/extend scent by 10 ft

Blinded Competence.name: Blinded Competence: Effect: while using Blinded Blade Style and blinded, gain blindsense (no concealment bonus for foes) within melee reach

Blinded Master.name: Blinded Master: Effect: Blinded Competence upgrades to blindsight, range 30 ft; +half character level to DC of Bluff checks to feint you

Blood Frenzy Style.name: Blood Frenzy Style: Activation: immediate action on taking damage; Effect: +2 Str, +2 Con, -2 AC while active

Blood Frenzy Strike.name: Blood Frenzy Strike: Effect: while using Blood Frenzy Style, unarmed/natural hits also deal [[1d6]] bleed (no stacking); Cost: 1/[[1d4]] rounds for one unarmed strike at -[[5]] that deals +[[2d6]] bludgeoning on a hit

Blood Frenzy Assault.name: Blood Frenzy Assault: Effect: while using Blood Frenzy Style, full attack gains one extra unarmed/natural attack per adjacent bleeding foe (-2 AC each until next turn); Blood Frenzy Strike's bleed increases to [[2d6]]

Boar Ferocity.name: Boar Ferocity: Effect: unarmed strikes also deal piercing dmg; +[[2]] Intimidate to demoralize; while using Boar Style, tearing flesh lets you demoralize as a free action

Brute Style.name: Brute Style: Effect: use Vicious Stomp vs any foe within [[10]] ft (if within reach), not just adjacent

Brute Stomp.name: Brute Stomp: Effect: while using Brute Style, a full attack incl. unarmed strike vs an adjacent prone foe gets one extra unarmed strike at your highest BAB; Vicious Stomp usable at full reach

Brute Assault.name: Brute Assault: Effect: while using Brute Style, an overrun/trip that drops a foe prone also deals [[1d6]] Str damage & halves its speed (Fort DC [[10 + @attributes.bab.total]] reduces to 1 Str dmg, negates speed loss)

Bulette Charge Style.name: Bulette Charge Style: Effect: +[[4]] on CMB checks to overrun while using this style

Bulette Leap.name: Bulette Leap: Effect: +Str mod on Acrobatics jump checks; can overrun multiple foes on a charge at cumulative -[[2]] per extra attempt (stop on a failure)

Bulette Rampage.name: Bulette Rampage: Effect: while using Bulette Charge Style, a successful overrun deals [[1d8]] (Medium)/[[1d6]] (Small) + half your armor AC bonus + 1.5x Str bonus dmg to the foe

Bull-Catcher Style.name: Bull-Catcher Style: Activation: standard action (readied); Effect: grapple a foe that moves 10+ ft into a threatened square (+2 vs charging foes); grappled foe limited to one natural attack; once/round

Bull-Catcher Toss.name: Bull-Catcher Toss: Effect: on a successful Bull-Catcher Style grapple, move the foe into any threatened square, then break grapple (immediate action) to shift it 5 ft further

Bull-Catcher Wrangler.name: Bull-Catcher Wrangler: Effect: vs a charging foe grappled with Bull-Catcher Style, reposition it (as Bull-Catcher Toss) then break grapple to redirect the charge at another foe in the new threatened area

Cerberus Style.name: Cerberus Style: Activation: standard action; Effect: full-BAB unarmed strike vs a foe in reach; on a hit, repeat vs up to 2 more foes in reach (-[[2]] AC per extra attack until next turn)

Cerberus Snare.name: Cerberus Snare: Effect: a foe damaged by Cerberus Style can't 5-ft step and is barred from dimensional travel (as dimensional anchor) until your next turn; SR applies

Cerberus Crush.name: Cerberus Crush: Effect: apply Vital Strike/Improved/Greater Vital Strike to all Cerberus Style attacks

Charging Stag Style.name: Charging Stag Style: Effect: charge through difficult terrain/allies' squares and turn up to 90 degrees mid-charge (not mounted); still only one attack at the end

Stag Horns.name: Stag Horns: Effect: a successful unarmed hit at the end of a Charging Stag Style charge grants a free grapple check vs the target, no AoO

Stag Submission.name: Stag Submission: Effect: a successful pin while using Charging Stag Style also knocks the foe prone or deals your unarmed strike damage, your choice

Cloak and Dagger Style.name: Cloak and Dagger Style: Effect: attacking with chosen weapon in a surprise round lets you attempt a free dirty trick vs that foe; foes provoke from you when removing a condition you inflicted via dirty trick

Cloak and Dagger Subterfuge.name: Cloak and Dagger Subterfuge: Effect: an AoO with chosen weapon lets you attempt a free dirty trick; a successful dirty trick lets you attempt a free, unnoticed steal

Cloak and Dagger Tactics.name: Cloak and Dagger Tactics: Effect: hitting a flat-footed/flanked/Vital-Strike foe with chosen weapon lets you attempt a free dirty trick (Fort DC [[10 + floor(@attributes.bab.total/2) + @abilities.int.mod]]) for a 1-round bonus condition; once/round

Crane Wing.name: Crane Wing: Effect: fighting defensively with a hand free grants +[[4]] dodge AC vs melee (lost until next turn if a hit misses you by 4 or less); on total defense, deflect one melee attack as a miss

Crashing Wave Style.name: Crashing Wave Style: Effect: on a successful drag/reposition, move [[5]] ft as an immediate action (even into the foe's old square) without provoking, even after a move action this round

Crashing Wave Buffet.name: Crashing Wave Buffet: Effect: a drag/reposition forces a Fort save (DC [[10 + floor(@attributes.hd.total/2) + @abilities.wis.mod]] +2/5 ft moved) or the foe takes -2 attack/CMB/Dex-skills until end of its next turn

Crashing Wave Fist.name: Crashing Wave Fist: Effect: during a drag/reposition, make one unarmed attack at your highest bonus, +1 more per 5 ft moved beyond the first (cumulative -[[5]] each)

Cudgeler Style.name: Cudgeler Style: Effect: nonlethal charge hit deals damage as a weapon one size category larger (first attack only)

Cudgeler Sweep.name: Cudgeler Sweep: Effect: a charge hit with Cudgeler Style lets you attempt a free trip check (+[[2]] competence, provokes as normal)

Cudgeler Takedown.name: Cudgeler Takedown: Effect: charge hit with Cudgeler Style deals damage as a weapon one size larger for 1 round/until dropped; a Cudgeler-Sweep trip also forces Fort DC [[10 + @attributes.hd.total + @abilities.str.mod]] or stun 1 round

Deadhand Style.name: Deadhand Style: Effect: while using this style, if you have at least 1 ki point, gain a +2 bonus on saves against fear effects and the Intimidate DC against you increases by 4; Cost: swift action, 1 ki point, to empower your unarmed strikes; Save: Will DC [[ 10 + floor(@attributes.hd.total/2) + @abilities.wis.mod ]] negates; Effect: creatures hit become shaken for a number of rounds equal to your Wisdom modifier (mind-affecting fear)

Deadhand Initiate.name: Deadhand Initiate: Effect: while using Deadhand Style with at least 1 ki point, the fear-save bonus increases to +4 and the Intimidate DC increase rises to +8; Activation: immediate action, 1 ki point, when targeted by a fear effect; Effect: gain temporary hit points equal to twice your Hit Dice

Deadhand Master.name: Deadhand Master: Cost: 2 ki points as a swift action; Activation: when you damage a living creature with an unarmed strike while using Deadhand Style; Effect: inflict 2 temporary negative levels with no saving throw; Save: Fortitude DC [[ 10 + floor(@attributes.hd.total/2) + @abilities.wis.mod ]] to remove the negative levels before they become permanent

Demonic Style.name: Demonic Style: Effect: while charging, gain a +1 bonus on the attack roll and deal +2 damage with melee attacks made as part of the charge

Demonic Momentum.name: Demonic Momentum: Effect: after bull rushing an opponent as part of a charge while using Demonic Style, gain +2 melee weapon damage against that opponent per 5 ft. it was moved (apply per increment manually), lasting until the end of your next turn; stacks with Demonic Style's damage bonus

Demonic Slaughter.name: Demonic Slaughter: Effect: while using Demonic Style, after successfully bull rushing an opponent as part of a charge, immediately use Great Cleave as though you had taken a standard action to do so; the bull rush target must be the target of the first Great Cleave attack

Diabolic Style.name: Diabolic Style: Effect: while using this style, an attack of opportunity with an unarmed strike deals 1 point of nonlethal damage; Save: Will DC [[ 10 + floor(@attributes.hd.total/2) + @abilities.cha.mod ]] negates the target becoming staggered for 1 round

Diabolic Humiliation.name: Diabolic Humiliation: Effect: a foe staggered by your Diabolic Style attack of opportunity can't gain the benefit of any morale bonus for 1 minute; during that minute, further staggered effects from your attacks of opportunity last 2 rounds instead of 1, and durations stack

Diabolic Judgment.name: Diabolic Judgment: Effect: while using Diabolic Style, the first time each round you hit with an attack of opportunity, you can apply the effects of any Vital Strike feat you have to that attack

Diva Style.name: Diva Style: Effect: use any Perform skill in place of Bluff to feint in combat; you can attempt a Perform check to feint as a move action when you begin a bardic performance

Diva Advance.name: Diva Advance: Effect: while using Diva Style, you don't provoke attacks of opportunity from creatures you've successfully feinted, and you can feint against a creature from up to 30 feet away

Diva Strike.name: Diva Strike: Effect: while using Diva Style, the first time you hit with a melee weapon each round against a target denied its Dexterity bonus to AC, deal extra precision damage equal to your Charisma modifier (not multiplied on a critical hit)

Djinni Style.name: Djinni Style: Cost: gain [[1]] additional Elemental Fist use per day; Effect: while using Elemental Fist to deal electricity damage, add your Wisdom bonus to the electricity damage roll; while using this style with Elemental Fist attempts remaining, gain a +[[2]] dodge bonus to AC against attacks of opportunity (lost if you lose your Dexterity bonus to AC)

Djinni Spirit.name: Djinni Spirit: Cost: gain [[1]] additional Elemental Fist use per day; Effect: while using Djinni Style, gain electricity resistance equal to your base attack bonus or monk level, whichever is higher (lost while denied your Dexterity bonus to AC); Save: Fortitude DC [[ 10 + floor(@attributes.hd.total/2) + @abilities.wis.mod ]] negates deafened for [[1d4]] rounds on creatures taking Elemental Fist electricity damage; creatures damaged by Djinni Spin are deafened even on a success

Dolphin Style.name: Dolphin Style: Effect: +[[1]] bonus on melee attack rolls against a creature adjacent to at least two of its other allies (as long as you aren't flanking it); your melee attacks ignore AC bonuses from the aid another action

Dolphin Circle.name: Dolphin Circle: Activation: full-round action underwater while using Dolphin Style; Effect: circle along a chosen path (length up to a single move action's swim distance) without provoking attacks of opportunity; you threaten and can be attacked or touched along the entire path until your next turn, when you choose a space along the path to stop circling

Dolphin Dart.name: Dolphin Dart: Activation: standard action underwater while using Dolphin Style; Effect: move up to half your swim speed, make a single melee attack against a creature within reach, then retreat to your previous position; the movement and attack don't provoke attacks of opportunity

Dragonfly Style.name: Dragonfly Style: Effect: add your Wisdom modifier to Acrobatics checks in addition to Dexterity; while adjacent to a vertical surface capable of supporting your weight, gain a +[[1]] bonus on melee attack rolls against opponents your size or smaller (as if on higher ground)

Dragonfly Wings.name: Dragonfly Wings: Effect: while using Dragonfly Style, the melee attack bonus for being adjacent to a vertical surface increases to +[[2]] and applies to opponents up to two size categories larger than you; you may substitute a creature your size or larger for the vertical surface (Acrobatics check vs. its CMD required if hostile; failing by 5+ provokes an attack of opportunity)

Dragonfly Flight.name: Dragonfly Flight: Activation: move action while using Dragonfly Style; Effect: Acrobatics check to high jump, then glide as the spell for 1 round; if you haven't used your standard action, you can charge while gliding (following the rules for charging with only a standard action)

Dwarven Hatred Style.name: Dwarven Hatred Style: Effect: apply your hatred racial trait's bonus to both attack rolls and weapon damage rolls (instead of only attack rolls) against creatures of the appropriate type or subtype, and increase the bonus to +[[2]]

Dwarven Seething.name: Dwarven Seething: Activation: immediate action while using Dwarven Hatred Style, when an opponent hits you with an attack (including an attack-roll spell); Effect: apply your defensive training or hatred racial trait bonus (your choice) against that target regardless of its type or subtype, until it dies, combat ends, you change styles, or you designate a different opponent

Dwarven Fury.name: Dwarven Fury: Effect: while using Dwarven Seething, maintain the defensive training and hatred racial trait bonuses against any number of opponents simultaneously

Earth Child Binder.name: Earth Child Binder: Effect: you can trip a creature of the giant subtype regardless of its size; while using Earth Child Style, if a prone giant-subtype creature provokes an attack of opportunity from you by standing up and you hit it with an unarmed strike, you can declare a Stunning Fist attempt after the hit, gaining a +[[4]] bonus to that Stunning Fist's DC

Efreeti Stance.name: Efreeti Stance: Cost: gain [[1]] additional Elemental Fist use per day; Effect: while using Efreeti Style, gain fire resistance equal to your base attack bonus or monk level plus non-monk base attack bonus, whichever is higher (lost while denied your Dexterity bonus to AC); Save: Reflex DC [[ 10 + floor(@attributes.hd.total/2) + @abilities.wis.mod ]] negates catching fire on creatures taking Elemental Fist fire damage

Efreeti Touch.name: Efreeti Touch: Cost: [[2]] Elemental Fist attempts; Activation: standard action while using Efreeti Style; Range: [[15]]-foot cone; Save: Reflex DC [[ 10 + floor(@attributes.hd.total/2) + @abilities.wis.mod ]] halves damage and negates catching fire; Effect: deals your unarmed strike damage plus Elemental Fist fire damage to creatures in the cone

Electric Eel Style.name: Electric Eel Style: Cost: gain [[1]] additional Elemental Fist use per day; Effect: while using this style, your Elemental Fist attack deals electricity damage; when a creature takes electricity damage from your Elemental Fist, gain a +[[4]] bonus for 1 round on combat maneuver checks to grapple that creature

Electric Eel Shock.name: Electric Eel Shock: Cost: gain [[1]] additional Elemental Fist use per day; Save: Fortitude DC [[ 10 + floor(@attributes.hd.total/2) + @abilities.wis.mod ]] negates; Effect: creatures that take electricity damage from your Elemental Fist attack (including from Electric Eel Conduit while grappled) become staggered for 1 round

Electric Eel Conduit.name: Electric Eel Conduit: Cost: gain [[1]] additional Elemental Fist use per day; then [[2]] Elemental Fist attempts as a swift action when you successfully grapple a creature; Effect: while you maintain the grapple, the target takes [[1d6]] plus your Wisdom modifier electricity damage each round

Elven Battle Style.name: Elven Battle Style: Effect: while wielding a longsword, rapier, or weapon with 'elven' in its name, combat maneuver checks made as attacks of opportunity with that weapon don't themselves provoke attacks of opportunity

Elven Battle Focus.name: Elven Battle Focus: Effect: while using Elven Battle Style with a longsword, rapier, or 'elven' weapon sized for you, add your Intelligence modifier to that weapon's damage instead of any other ability modifier (do not stack with Strength or another ability-based damage bonus)

Elven Battle Torrent.name: Elven Battle Torrent: Effect: while using Elven Battle Style, any opponent who misses you with an attack while you're fighting defensively, using total defense, or using Combat Expertise provokes an attack of opportunity from you (once per round even with Combat Reflexes)

Empty Quiver Style.name: Empty Quiver Style: Effect: make melee attacks with your chosen ranged weapon as if it were a heavy mace (light mace for a hand crossbow or one-handed firearm), without automatically threatening the area around you; freely switch between melee and ranged attacks with it, even in the same round; ignore the elf prerequisite for Stabbing Shot, and Stabbing Shot can be used with a crossbow or firearm if you have it

Empty Quiver Flexibility.name: Empty Quiver Flexibility: Effect: while using Empty Quiver Style, apply feats and class abilities that modify your ranged attack and damage rolls with the chosen weapon to melee attack and damage rolls with it instead; you also threaten the area around you as if wielding a melee weapon

Empty Quiver Flurry.name: Empty Quiver Flurry: Effect: while using Empty Quiver Style or Stabbing Shot to attack in melee, on a hit, ranged attacks you make with the same weapon against that foe don't provoke attacks of opportunity from it until the start of your next turn

Fox Style.name: Fox Style: Effect: use your base attack bonus in place of your Bluff ranks to feint in combat or create a distraction to hide; if Intelligence 19+, gain a +4 bonus on such Bluff checks when adding your Charisma modifier

Fox Insight.name: Fox Insight: Effect: while using Fox Style, use your base attack bonus in place of Sense Motive ranks to oppose feints, and foes demoralizing you gain no size bonus for being larger (though still suffer a penalty for being smaller); if Intelligence 19+, the DC to demoralize or feint you increases by 4

Fox Trickery.name: Fox Trickery: Effect: while using Fox Style, perform dirty trick combat maneuvers as attacks of opportunity; if Intelligence 19+, gain a +4 bonus on dirty trick combat maneuver checks

Grabbing Style.name: Grabbing Style: Effect: no -4 penalty on combat maneuver checks to grapple a foe with only one hand; don't lose your Dexterity bonus to AC while pinning an opponent

Grabbing Drag.name: Grabbing Drag: Effect: while using Grabbing Style, the move-grapple action lets you move yourself and a single grappled target your full speed (instead of half); afterward, a move action lets you both move half speed without an additional combat maneuver check; unusable while grappling two targets

Grabbing Master.name: Grabbing Master: Effect: while grabbing two opponents with Grabbing Style, use your grapple to move or damage either or both opponents instead of just one

Illusive Gnome Style.name: Illusive Gnome Style: Cost: sacrifice a spell slot, illusion spell, or gnome magic racial spell; Effect: while feinting with a melee weapon with 'gnome' in its name, gain a bonus on the feint check equal to 1 + the level of the spell sacrificed (sacrificing a 0-level spell locks it out for 24 hours)

Illusive Gnome Surprise.name: Illusive Gnome Surprise: Effect: while using Illusive Gnome Style, gain a +2 bonus on dirty trick combat maneuver checks and Bluff checks to feint; on a successful feint, instead of denying Dexterity bonus to AC, treat a wielded 'gnome' weapon as having one chosen special feature (blocking, brace, disarm, distracting, performance, sunder, or trip) against that foe for a number of rounds equal to your Charisma modifier (minimum 1)

Illusive Gnome Bewilderment.name: Illusive Gnome Bewilderment: Effect: while using Illusive Gnome Style, on a successful feint, deny the target's Dexterity bonus to AC as normal and pick one special weapon feature from Illusive Gnome Surprise's list, or pick two features instead of one

Indomitable Mountain Style.name: Indomitable Mountain Style: Effect: as long as you don't take a move action, gain a +4 morale bonus to your CMD and to the DC of Bluff checks to feint you; you're treated as one size category larger when creatures attempt Acrobatics checks to move through your threatened squares without provoking attacks of opportunity

Indomitable Mountain Peak.name: Indomitable Mountain Peak: Effect: whenever a foe succeeds at a combat maneuver against you or an Acrobatics check to avoid an attack of opportunity from moving through your threatened square, gain a +2 morale bonus to your CMD against the next combat maneuver or to the DC of the next such Acrobatics check; stacks until an attempt fails against you
